mapper.select:
select mn.*, sc1.C_Name as clientUnitName, sc2.C_Name as supervisionUnitName, (select REPLACE(WM_CONCAT(pp.P_Name), ',', '；') from Con_Contract_Multi_Project ccmp left join Pre_Project pp on ccmp.p_Id = pp.P_ID where ccmp.ccm_Id = mn.id ) as pNames from Con_Contract_Multi mn left join SYS_Company sc1 on mn.client_Unit_Id = sc1.C_ID left join SYS_Company sc2 on mn.supervision_Unit_Id = sc2.C_ID
order by mn.Create_Time desc

select mn.*, sc1.C_Name as clientUnitName, sc2.C_Name as supervisionUnitName, (select GROUP_CONCAT(pp.P_Name SEPARATOR '；') from Con_Contract_Multi_Project ccmp left join Pre_Project pp on ccmp.p_Id = pp.P_ID where ccmp.ccm_Id = mn.id ) as pNames from Con_Contract_Multi mn left join SYS_Company sc1 on mn.client_Unit_Id = sc1.C_ID left join SYS_Company sc2 on mn.supervision_Unit_Id = sc2.C_ID
order by mn.Create_Time desc
